mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, name, permission_key, type, path, component, icon, sort, visible, status, create_time, update_time FROM crm_permission WHERE permission_key = #{permissionCode} AND status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.parent_id, p.name, p.permission_key, p.type, p.path, p.component, p.icon, p.sort, p.visible, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM crm_permission p INNER JOIN crm_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN crm_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort

SELECT p.id, p.parent_id, p.name, p.permission_key, p.type, p.path, p.component, p.icon, p.sort, p.visible, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM crm_permission p INNER JOIN crm_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort
SELECT id, parent_id, name, permission_key, type, path, component, icon, sort, visible, status, create_time, update_time FROM crm_permission WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort
SELECT id, parent_id, name, permission_key, type, path, component, icon, sort, visible, status, create_time, update_time FROM crm_permission WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_role_permission WHERE permission_id = #{permissionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_permission WHERE parent_id = #{permissionId}
